[P2] Make the skipped-branch fixture deterministic

This parallel uses unlimited concurrency, so `branch-b` can succeed or win instead of being skipped. In that valid scheduling outcome, `observe(skipped)` calls a normal branch's `get()` from a STEP thread, and `validateCurrentThreadCanWaitForDurableOperation()` throws `IllegalStateException`. The step retries/fails and the test intermittently rejects correct execution. Establish a deterministic skipped branch and observe/assert its outcome on the context thread, outside the checkpointed step body, so replay also evaluates the assertion.
